title: Record Count & Completeness
requirement: Target must contain exactly the same order_id key set as the immutable Source snapshot of this pipeline run (normally 10,000 orders, smaller test runs supported). Query source_orders and target_orders. Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count: zero when key sets match, positive when keys are missing or unexpected. Gold aggregates by UTC order date: reconcile total order_count, not the number of Gold rows. Equal row counts alone do not prove completeness.
learning_objectives: Explain pipeline execution success versus data quality success.
Compare counts at boundaries with the same data grain.
Confirm completeness with key-set comparison, beyond row counts.
